acceptanceCriteria: The record contract carries an observed/generated marker, selection in `internal/extevidence/selection.go` can filter on it, and a fixture pins both kinds.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

Provider records do not say whether an item was observed (a test ran, a file was read at a revision) or generated (inferred by a model or heuristic). Corvint's own ranking treats provider evidence as external and separate, but a consumer cannot down-weight or exclude generated items. Issue #64 asks for the distinction in the evidence kind.

completion.reason: BUILD-LOG generated-evidence-kind entry, decision 0350: internal/extevidence/selection.go generated-only-evidence (EEP-V0-007, EEP-V0-019, ETS-V0-014); TestEvidenceKindGeneratedAdmitted in internal/extevidence/extevidence_test.go. The ported issue-64 entry that says stay open predates this on the old lineage.

title: extevidence: no generated-vs-observed evidence-kind distinction
